title: Fixed window sum
statement: Start simple: Return the largest sum of any contiguous block of exactly width elements. The theory is optional. The C solution appears after the hidden tests pass.
constraints: width is at least 1 and no larger than the array.
think: Recalculating every block repeats most additions.
The next block differs by one entering and one leaving value.
Start with the first full window.
Update the best sum as the window moves right.
hints: Subtract the value that falls out on the left.
Negative values mean you cannot keep only positive sums.
